title: Export notifications: success caption, "Empty export" warning, and the failure error message
refs: specs/wip-work-in-progress.md Story 9 S9-R11; S9-R12; S9-R13; §7 User Feedback Summary
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The report can be put in three states: rows present, no rows visible (filters leave nothing), and (if simulatable) a failing download, for example by disconnecting the network before the download.
custom_steps:
1. With rows present, download the current tab and read the notification.
2. Filter the report until no rows are visible, download again, and read the notification.
3. If simulatable, force a download failure (for example, drop the network) and read the notification.
custom_expected:
1. On a successful download, a success notification shows with the caption "Data exported successfully."
2. When a download yields no rows, a warning notification shows titled "Empty export" with the caption "Export didn't yield any results".
3. When a download fails, an error notification shows: "An error occurred while exporting the report. Please try again."
